About SOLVIX

A Naples-Based Construction & Remodeling Company

Based in Naples, we work across Naples, Miami, and Fort Myers — with more than 5 years of hands-on experience.

We specialize in residential work: replacing old floors and installing new ones, drywall and finishing, wall painting, tile of every kind, full bathrooms and kitchens, furniture assembly, and light fixtures when needed. Our focus is private homes, but our team is just as capable on larger projects.

Our crew takes on any job, and several of our team members bring deep, hands-on experience across every area of construction. Whatever the task, we do it to a high standard.

  • ✓ Based in Naples — serving Naples, Miami & Fort Myers
  • ✓ 5+ years of hands-on experience
  • ✓ Skilled team experienced in every area of construction
  • ✓ High-quality work, from small fixes to full remodels
What We Do

Services We Provide

A full range of construction and remodeling work for your home — handled by one experienced team.

Flooring

Removing old floors and installing new ones — laminate, hardwood, vinyl, and more, laid clean and level.

Drywall & Finishing

Drywall installation, patching, and smooth finishing that leaves your walls ready for paint.

Painting

Interior wall painting with clean lines and an even, professional finish throughout.

Tile Work

All types of tile for floors, walls, showers, and backsplashes — precise and built to last.

Bathrooms & Kitchens

Full bathroom and kitchen remodels, from layout and tile to fixtures and finishing touches.

Finishing Touches

Furniture assembly, light fixture installation, and the small details that complete the job.
